title: Place Controls in the Right Zones
prompt: For each control, indicate the zone where it must be placed to be effective: Perimeter/DMZ, Internal network, Out-of-band management (OOB), or Endpoint/identity.

items.label: NIDS sensor on a mirror port of the public server segment
Internal firewall between two user segments
Administration jump host (bastion) with MFA and session recording
Management network separated from production for network devices
EDR agent verifying the health of each workstation
Least privilege policy and periodic access reviews
VPN concentrator terminating remote worker tunnels
Device posture check before Zero Trust application access
Segmentation blocking lateral movement between departments

explain: Placement follows the flow to be protected: the perimeter filters ingress, internal controls limit lateral movement, out-of-band isolates administration, and the endpoint verifies identity and posture. A preventive control is inline; a detective sensor can be out-of-band.
